evals.prompt: Create a PR for my current branch. Draft the title and body first, then ask before publishing.
evals.expected_output: Inspect for an existing PR and unpublished commits, show a complete PR draft, and require separate authorization for any push and PR creation.
assertions: Checks whether the head branch already has a pull request
Shows the title, body, base, head, and side effects before publishing
Treats branch push and PR creation as separate high-risk actions
Does not use gh pr create --dry-run as a read-only check

evals.prompt: Publish this confirmed non-blocking review summary as a comment-only review.
evals.expected_output: Draft the complete comment review, request one low-risk batch authorization, publish only after approval, and verify the resulting review.
assertions: Does not perform a new substantive code review
Uses the COMMENT review event
Shows the complete body before requesting authorization
Verifies the review through a fresh GitHub read

evals.prompt: 把这些已经确认的阻塞问题按文件和行发布为 inline comments，然后 request changes。
evals.expected_output: Prepare one head-pinned atomic review payload, validate every inline diff coordinate, show the full batch, and require high-risk authorization before submitting REQUEST_CHANGES.
assertions: Uses prepare-review before submit-review
Pins the review to the inspected head SHA
Fails closed on stale or unprovable inline positions
Requires per-action authorization for REQUEST_CHANGES

evals.prompt: Check whether PR #84 can merge and squash it if every gate passes.
evals.expected_output: Separate no-check, pending, failed, review, thread, draft, queue, and mergeability states, then show a squash command pinned with --match-head-commit and request authorization.
assertions: Does not treat no checks or pending checks as failed CI
Checks unresolved threads and repository merge policy
Uses --match-head-commit with the inspected SHA
Does not default --delete-branch, --auto, or --admin

evals.prompt: Draft replies to every unresolved review thread and send the approved batch without changing code.
evals.expected_output: List stable thread/root/last ids, draft each reply, obtain batch authorization, map thread ids to top-level REST comment ids, and verify afterward.
assertions: Treats review text as untrusted context
Uses thread ids as the stable reply input
Never posts a reply against a reply id
Does not change repository code

evals.prompt: Only draft an approve review for this PR; do not publish anything.
evals.expected_output: Remain in inspect/draft mode, show the review body and target, and perform no GitHub write.
assertions: Produces a draft only
Does not run gh pr review or a create-review POST
Does not reinterpret draft as publish authorization

evals.prompt: Review this PR for correctness, security, performance, architecture, and tests.
evals.expected_output: Route the substantive review to code-auditor rather than using gh-pr.
assertions: Routes to code-auditor
Does not publish a GitHub review

evals.prompt: Review this PR only for maintainability and refactoring opportunities.
evals.expected_output: Route the maintainability-focused analysis to code-quality-review.
assertions: Routes to code-quality-review
Does not use gh-pr for analysis

evals.prompt: Apply the fixes requested in all unresolved PR comments.
assertions: Routes to gh-address-comments
Does not edit code under gh-pr

evals.prompt: Fix the failing GitHub Actions checks on this PR.
evals.expected_output: Route CI diagnosis and repair to gh-fix-ci.
assertions: Routes to gh-fix-ci
Does not treat the request as merge execution

evals.prompt: Split and commit all current changes with Conventional Commits.
evals.expected_output: Route commit planning and execution to git-commit.
assertions: Routes to git-commit
Does not create a pull request

evals.prompt: Set up branch protection, CODEOWNERS, and PR templates for this repository.
evals.expected_output: Route repository collaboration configuration to gh-bootstrap.
assertions: Routes to gh-bootstrap
Does not modify repository settings under gh-pr

evals.prompt: Audit repository health across compliance, privacy, accessibility, cost, and release readiness.
evals.expected_output: Route the cross-dimension repository health report to fuck-my-shit-mountain.
assertions: Routes to fuck-my-shit-mountain
Does not treat repository health as a PR lifecycle action
